issues.problem: tasya belongs to the printed token 'dukhamāyustasya' but the draft put it as the first word of the next token 'hitāhitam'. The words of each token must come from that token.
issues.fix: dukhamāyustasya => duḥkham [unhappy | n. nom. sg.] + āyuḥ [life | n. nom. sg.] + tasya [for it | n. gen. sg.]; hitāhitam => hita-ahitam [what is wholesome and unwholesome | n. nom. sg. dvandva]

issues.problem: Inconsistent with 44, which renders 'Sameness (sāmānya)' and 'difference (viśeṣa)'; here bare Sanskrit is used.
issues.fix: Sameness (sāmānya) produces oneness, while difference (viśeṣa) produces separateness; sameness is indeed likeness of things, and difference is the opposite.
